description: This file contains the implementation of the ModelFormField class, which models the <field> element of a form in the Apache OFBiz framework. It defines data structures for various field types (check, date, container, etc.), handles field properties, rendering, and dynamic evaluation based on context. The class is part of the widget model package and facilitates form field configurations, including validation and custom rendering.

classes.name: ModelFormField.AutoComplete
classes.description: Models the <auto-complete> element with properties for autocomplete behavior in form fields.

classes.name: ModelFormField.CheckField
classes.description: Models the <check> element for checkbox fields, extending FieldInfoWithOptions with additional properties.

classes.name: ModelFormField.ContainerField
classes.description: Models the <container> element, extending FieldInfo to encapsulate container-specific behavior.

classes.name: ModelFormField.DateFindField
classes.description: Models the <date-find> element with date range options, extending DateTimeField.

classes.name: ModelFormField.DateTimeField
classes.description: Models the <date-time> element with date/time specific properties and rendering methods.

classes.name: ModelFormField.DateRangePickerField
classes.description: Models the <date-range-picker> element, encapsulating properties for date range selection UI.

methods.name: getDefaultDateTimeString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the default date/time value based on the field type or current timestamp.

methods.name: isTwelveHour
methods.description: Indicates if the date/time field uses a 12-hour clock format.

methods.name: useMask

methods.name: renderFieldString
